setting.name: skroutz_feed_url_setting
setting.help: Give this URL to Skroutz to fetch your product feed.

setting.name: skroutz_feed_token_setting
setting.help: Optional secret token appended to the feed URL (?token=...). Leave empty to disable protection.

setting.name: skroutz_default_avail_setting
setting.help: Availability label shown when a product has 0 stock.

setting.name: skroutz_zero_stock_setting
setting.help: Keep products with 0 stock in the feed. Skroutz recommends this so products reactivate automatically when stock returns.

setting.name: skroutz_api_token_setting
setting.help: Bearer token from your Skroutz merchant panel (Merchants > Services > Skroutz Marketplace). One token per shop.

setting.name: skroutz_webhook_secret_setting
setting.help: Optional secret token embedded in the webhook URL. Register the full URL (including the secret) in your Skroutz merchant panel. Skroutz does not sign webhook requests, so the URL token is the only authentication.

field.name: skroutz_webhook_secret
field.placeholder: Leave empty for the plain webhook URL

div.small: Webhook URL: /skroutz/webhook/<secret> (or /skroutz/webhook when no secret is set)

setting.name: skroutz_auto_sale_order_setting
setting.help: Automatically create a linked Odoo Sale Order when a Skroutz order is accepted.
